study: Current JMdict descriptor tail novelty check
status: No prototype; related mechanisms already under qualification
observationScope: Historical 9e10 single ordinary observation, diagnostic attribution only
sourceFinding: The 45-byte JMdict descriptor remains buffered until finalization. Current code serially prepares/drains it before starting descriptor close and sidecar finalization together. A potential earlier pending flush was considered, but related independently owned finalization experiments already cover removal of this serial dependency.
